purpose: Teach: マヤ/デビッド/アンドリュー/トマス/ザック/ゲール/キティ/マンセー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でマヤ文明調べてたな
lines.en: You were studying the Maya civilization in social studies, weren't you, Riku?
lines.style: Light tease with genuine curiosity underneath. Quick tempo, almost playful rhythm. Eyes bright — she's caught him in something small and harmless.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でデビッド・ゲッタの曲聴いてたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were listening to David Guetta in music class, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-volley, eyes meeting hers. Calm delivery — he's been waiting for this moment. Small smile in the voice, no apology.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でアンドリュー大統領習ったろ
lines.en: You learned about President Andrew Jackson in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Continuing the thread, still curious but sharper now. Slight acceleration — she's pushing back playfully. Testing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、機関車トーマス、つまりトマスの絵本好きだったよな、桜
lines.en: And you were always reading those Thomas the Tank Engine picture books, remember?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Not mean — just fact-checking her with quiet amusement. Unbothered, almost gentle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、映画でザック・エフロン好きだったな
lines.en: You had a crush on Zac Efron in that movie, didn't you?
lines.style: Escalating the teasing now — bolder, slight grin in the voice. Faster rhythm. She knows she's landing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の授業でゲール語、つまりゲール文化習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about Gaelic culture in English class, though, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with his own card to play. Measured pace. Not defensive — collaborative teasing. Equal footing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハローキティ好きだって告白してたな
lines.en: You admitted you liked Hello Kitty, remember?
lines.style: Closer to vulnerability now — she's using his own weapons against him. Voice lighter, less protected. Still teasing but with affection creeping in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、韓国ドラマでマンセー、つまり「マンセー!」って言葉聞いたな、桜
lines.en: And you heard that word 'Mansae!' in a Korean drama, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final volley — quiet and assured. Slight trailing-off on her name, like they've reached the end of this round and he's satisfied. Genuine warmth beneath.
